---
title: "Education"
listing:
  # The FAQ "wheel": every education/faq-*.qmd page, in FAQ-number order.
  # To add one, publish its page (delete its `draft: true` line) and give it
  # the next number in its title ("FAQ #4: ..."), `order:` and a `date:`.
  - id: faq-wheel
    contents: "education/faq-*.qmd"
    template: faq-carousel.ejs.md
    sort: "order"
    date-format: "MMMM D, YYYY"
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
  # Longer posts: every page in education/posts/, newest first, plus the
  # outside links listed in education/longer-reads-links.yml.
  - id: posts
    contents:
      - "education/posts/*.qmd"
      - "education/longer-reads-links.yml"
    template: education-posts.ejs.md
    sort: "date desc"
    date-format: "MMMM D, YYYY"
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
toc: false
body-classes: education-page
---
